intro: Lieutenant Orrin is an officer of the Argent Dawn stationed at the gates of Stormwind City. Positioned in the Valley of Heroes, he coordinates local defense against incursions by the Scourge and directs fresh recruits to investigate undead threats outside the capital's walls.

p: While the Argent Dawn is primarily known for holding the front lines in the ruined north, their presence extends south to safeguard vital strongholds like Stormwind City. Lieutenant Orrin stands near the towering statues of the Valley of Heroes, watching the road for signs of corruption. When necromantic magic stirs outside the capital, he is tasked with sounding the alarm and rallying adventurers before foul forces can threaten the populace.

Orrin acts as a primary liaison between the independent order and volunteers within the southern kingdom. When signs of the Scourge surface beyond the city gates, he marshals able-bodied scouts and sends them out to gather intelligence and secure hazardous artifacts, such as cracked necrotic crystals, to better understand and repel the undead threat.
